snippet.title: Persona 4 Revival: Pre-order Trailer | XBOX Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
You ever heard… of the Midnight Channel? 📺

Mark your calendars - Persona 4 Revival goes on air February 18th, 2027!

Persona 4 Revival is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
